services.desc: There’s one thing for certain with Crossfit. It has the ability to improve your fitness and health drastically when performed correctly and consistently. This has been proven since 2000 when Greg Classman created the fitness regime in California. Since then, it has proven results with people all over the world that have chosen CrossFit as their fitness regime. The first and original CrossFit gym was in Santa Cruz, California, and the first affiliated gym was CrossFit North in Seattle, Washington.
